_comment: #1432: records the last JOINTLY REVIEWED en/ja text for reader-facing key claims (title, hero.tagline, description) — a staleness tracker (gettext fuzzy-match / Crowdin last-synced-source shape), never a literal-translation-equality check (#718 already ruled ja prose is not a translation of en). scripts/check-hero-sync.mjs compares each language's CURRENT text against its OWN recorded value here; a mismatch means that field changed since the last joint review, not that the two languages disagree. A field with no entry here is an open refusal, not a silent pass — see the fields intentionally left unrecorded below.

hero.title.en: A wiki for the age of AI
hero.title.ja: AI 時代の、新しい Wiki。
hero.title._reviewed: #1397 (2026-09-18): both sides landed together in this exact wording — bootstrapped here as the baseline.

hero.tagline.en: Share a link and anyone edits with you, live — no accounts. Markdown-first, open formats, pages that link to each other, publish anywhere, self-hostable.
hero.tagline.ja: リンクを渡すだけで、アカウント不要のまま全員でリアルタイムに書けます。Markdown のまま書けて、リンクでつながり、どこへでも公開できて、セルフホストもできます。
hero.tagline._reviewed: #1397 (2026-09-19): owner read the en/ja pair. ja named two product pillars en did not (Link First, Publish anywhere); the ruling was to ADD them to en rather than cut them from ja, because both are shipped features and are the differentiators an English reader most needs. en amended in the same change; both sides recorded here.

description.en: A collaborative knowledge base — share a link, anyone edits together. Markdown-first, open formats, self-hostable.
description.ja: 共有リンクで誰でも同時編集できるナレッジベース。Markdown ファースト・オープンフォーマット・セルフホスト可能。
description._reviewed: #1397 (2026-09-19): owner read the en/ja pair. Already making the same three claims (share-link co-editing, Markdown-first/open formats, self-hostable) — no copy change needed, recorded as-is.
